projectState.summary: Track A3 is implemented on codex/byte-a3-selection. The branch adds per-kind selectCandidates() to the candidate store, using deterministic fitness/generation/created_at/id ordering to mark top eliteLimit candidates elite and purge overflow with existing candidate.retained/candidate.purged audit events carrying reason:"selection" and rank. It is exposed through /api/persistence/candidates/select, the persistence client, and window.persistence.selectCandidates(), but no audio/model/playback/generator loop consumes selection. Validation: build green, db:smoke green, smoke 42/42, diff-check green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories. Next likely Track A4: clone elite candidates into bounded child candidates, deep-cloning genomes before mutation.
